test_title: PYST 69: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Pointing towards a photo of a lady. Ram said. "She is the sister of my mother's daughter". How lady is related to Ram?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given statement: Pointing towards a photo of a lady. Ram said. "She is the sister of my mother's daughter". 

As gender of Ram is not known, therefore there are two possible cases.

Case 1) Ram is the sibling of the Lady.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e8096e901c928c29eff61efd72d739728d89c7304c812d3632dce3dbc232c35.png] 

Case 2) If Ram is female, then Ram is the lady.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06eaf81679457fbafcea36503e6c1401daa9381055d9a3e7caab5761daa74317.png] 

 

So, the lady can be either sister of Ram or Ram herself.

As out of all the options, 'Sister' is given, therefore case 2 will be eliminated.

Thus, the lady is Ram's sister.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
